title: Organization
description: A HOTL organization (ADR 0024): the top-level tenant under which projects live. Maps 1:1 to a GitHub organization by default and owns org-wide rules, knowledge and shared toolchain images.

version.description: Version of the organization record, from 1. Assigned by the review service.

githubOrg.description: GitHub organization name, for example HumanOnLoop. Defaults to org when omitted.
